title.en: Income Tax (International Tax Compliance Agreements) (United States of America) Order 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (International Tax Compliance Agreements) (United States of America) Order 2020 and comes into operation on 1 January 2021.

heading.en: Declaration as international tax compliance agreement

text.en: 2. The agreement reached between the Government of the Republic of Singapore and the Government of the United States of America to improve international tax compliance and to implement the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), done at Singapore on 13 November 2018, as corrected by agreement between the Government of the Republic of Singapore and the Government of the United States of America on 27 November 2019, is declared as an international tax compliance agreement for the purposes of Part XXB of the Act.
